_about: Which sites count as official, the company's own, press-release wires or news when a post's sources are ranked. Edit this file, point SOURCE_SITES_FILE at another one, or override a list with its environment variable (comma separated): SOURCE_OFFICIAL_ENDINGS, SOURCE_OFFICIAL_SITES, SOURCE_COMPANY_SITES, SOURCE_COMPANY_SITE_WORDS, SOURCE_RELEASE_WIRES, SOURCE_NEWS_SITES.
